datasets.name: sales_to_date
datasets.query:
with period as (
  select cast(date_trunc('month', cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()) as date)) as date) as period_start,
         cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()) as date) as period_end
),
cutoff as (
  select p.period_start,
         least(p.period_end, coalesce((select max(actuals_as_of_date) from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily"), p.period_end)) as effective_end,
         exists (select 1 from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily" t
                 where t.hierarchy_level = 'material_group' and t.business_date between p.period_start and p.period_end) as targets_available
  from period p
),
stores as (
  select store_code, any_value(store_name) as store_name, any_value(short_code) as short_code
  from "gold"."masters"."store" group by 1
),
names as (
  select material_group_code, any_value(subcategory) as subcategory
  from "gold"."masters"."merchandise_hierarchy" where material_group_code is not null group by 1
),
targets as (
  select t.plant_code, t.hierarchy_code, t.business_date, t.target_daily_before_tax, t.actual_before_tax,
         t.target_quantity, t.actual_quantity
  from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily" t cross join cutoff c
  where t.hierarchy_level = 'material_group' and t.business_date between c.period_start and c.effective_end
),
sales as (
  select s.store_code as plant_code, lpad(s.material_group, 9, '0') as hierarchy_code, s.business_date,
         sum(s.sales_before_tax_net) as actual_before_tax, sum(s.qty_net) as actual_quantity
  from "gold"."sales"."sales_item_daily" s cross join cutoff c
  where s.material_group is not null and s.business_date between c.period_start and c.effective_end
  group by 1, 2, 3
),
days as (
  select coalesce(t.plant_code, s.plant_code) as plant_code,
         coalesce(t.hierarchy_code, s.hierarchy_code) as hierarchy_code,
         t.target_daily_before_tax as target,
         case when t.plant_code is not null then t.actual_before_tax else s.actual_before_tax end as actual,
         t.target_quantity,
         case when t.plant_code is not null then t.actual_quantity else s.actual_quantity end as actual_quantity
  from targets t
  full join sales s on s.plant_code = t.plant_code and s.hierarchy_code = t.hierarchy_code and s.business_date = t.business_date
)
select d.plant_code as store_code, st.store_name, st.short_code,
       d.hierarchy_code as subcategory_code, n.subcategory,
       sum(d.target) as target, sum(d.actual) as actual,
       count(d.actual) as days_with_actual, count(*) as days,
       c.period_start, c.effective_end as data_through, c.targets_available,
       count(d.target) as target_days,
       sum(d.target_quantity) as target_quantity, sum(d.actual_quantity) as actual_quantity
from days d
cross join cutoff c
left join stores st on st.store_code = d.plant_code
left join names n on n.material_group_code = d.hierarchy_code
group by d.plant_code, st.store_name, st.short_code, d.hierarchy_code, n.subcategory, c.period_start, c.effective_end, c.targets_available

datasets.name: sales_month
datasets.query:
with period as (
  select cast(date_trunc('month', cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()) as date)) as date) as period_start,
         cast(timezone('Asia/Kolkata', now()) as date) as period_end
),
cutoff as (
  select p.period_start,
         least(p.period_end, coalesce((select max(actuals_as_of_date) from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily"), p.period_end)) as effective_end,
         exists (select 1 from "marts"."sales"."target_vs_actual_daily" t
                 where t.hierarchy_level = 'material_group' and t.business_date between p.period_start and p.period_end) as targets_available
  from period p
),
pairs as (
  select s.store_code, s.store_name, h.material_group_code as subcategory_code
  from (select store_code, any_value(store_name) as store_name from "gold"."masters"."store" group by 1) s
  cross join (select distinct material_group_code from "gold"."masters"."merchandise_hierarchy" where material_group_code is not null) h
)
select pr.store_code, pr.store_name, pr.subcategory_code, c.period_start, c.effective_end as data_through, c.targets_available
from pairs pr cross join cutoff c

tables.name: dash.report
tables.label: Dash report
tables.description: One Dive Dash can open: its name, its MotherDuck id, and how a reader's reach becomes that Dive's filters. Holds no business data.

columns.label: Report key
columns.description: A readable key that stays the same, used in the page's address and by report bundles.

columns.label: Name
columns.description: What people read in the sidebar.

columns.label: MotherDuck Dive
columns.description: The Dive's id. Dash opens its latest saved version.

columns.label: Filters
columns.choices:
One store and subcategories
Whole stores
Stores and subcategories
No filter
columns.description: How a reader's reach is sent. A reach the shape can't express is refused, never widened.

columns.label: Store key
columns.description: The Dive's state key for the store, the list of stores, or each store's reach.

columns.label: Subcategory key
columns.description: One store only: the Dive's state key for a section reader's subcategories.

columns.label: Whole store key
columns.description: One store only: the Dive's state key saying the reader covers the whole store.

columns.label: Month key
columns.description: The Dive's state key for the last day of the chosen month. Empty: the report has no month picker.

columns.label: Says when drawn
columns.description: The Dive posts dash:dive-ready once it has drawn.

columns.label: Quick view
columns.description: The built-in table shown when the Dive can't load. Empty: a message instead.

columns.label: Pickers in the Dive
columns.description: The Dive has its own Store and Month pickers: Dash sends the reader's reach and shows no bar or store heading over it.

tables.name: dash.report_bundle
tables.label: Report bundle
tables.description: A named group of reports, given together. Its reports are its Report bundle member rows.

columns.label: Name
columns.description: What the Report access page calls it, for example Team leader pack.

columns.label: Notes
columns.description: Who it is for, in a line.

tables.name: dash.report_bundle_member
tables.label: Report bundle member
tables.description: One report in one bundle. Taking the row away takes the report out of the bundle for everyone given it, on their next request.

columns.label: Member key
columns.description: Set on save: the bundle and the report, while the report is in it. Unique, so a bundle holds a report once.

columns.label: Removed
columns.description: Taken out of the bundle: the row stays so its history says who took it out and when.

tables.name: dash.report_access
tables.label: Report access
tables.description: Gives one report or one bundle to one person, one role or one job. A person sees every report given to them by any route; no row means no report.

columns.label: Report
columns.description: The report given. Fill in this or Bundle, not both.

columns.label: Bundle
columns.description: The bundle given. Fill in this or Report, not both.

columns.label: Person
columns.description: Given to this person: their Featherbase id, which the Report access page shows by name. Fill in one of Person, Role and Job.

columns.label: Role
columns.description: Given to everyone holding this role.

columns.label: Job
columns.description: Given to everyone whose current job assignment is this job, for example Team Leader.

columns.label: Access key
columns.description: Set on save: what is given and to whom, while it is given. Unique, so the same thing is never given twice to the same receiver.

columns.label: Removed
columns.description: Taken away: the row stays so its history says who removed it and when, and it gives nothing.

columns.label: Given by
columns.description: Set when given on the Report access page: the name of the person who gave it, as the page shows it.

table.name: dash.designation_alias
table.label: Designation alias
table.description: A source system's spelling of a designation, matched as a whole value. Central: the same in every company and store.

columns.label: Alias
columns.description: The title exactly as the source system spells it.

columns.label: Alias key
columns.description: Set on save: the source and the alias. Unique.

table.name: dash.employment
table.label: Employment
table.description: One stint of a person working for one legal company, from joined_on up to but not including left_on. A rejoin is a new row; one person's stints at one company never overlap.

columns.label: Legal company
columns.description: The employing company's code, as the organisation's Legal Company master names it.

columns.label: Employee number
columns.description: The number this company issued for this stint. A rejoin may carry a new number; one number never belongs to two people at one company.

columns.label: Left on
columns.description: Exclusive: the first day the person no longer works here, the day after their last working day. Empty means current.

columns.label: Leaving reason
columns.description: Why the stint ended, as the HR system gives it. Empty while current.

table.name: dash.employee
table.label: Employee
table.description: A person who works, or has worked, for the group, with their operational contacts. Changes here never change sign-in or account-recovery identifiers. Employee numbers belong to employments, never to the person.

columns.label: Person
columns.description: The person, who keeps their own permanent number across every employment.

table.name: dash.job_alias
table.label: Job alias
table.description: Another system's name for a job, matched as a whole value. Central: the same in every store.

columns.label: Job
columns.choices:
Director
Chief Operating Officer
Cluster Manager
Store Manager
Floor Manager
Department Manager
Team Leader
Staff

columns.label: Alias key
columns.description: Set on save: the source and the alias. Unique.

table.name: dash.floor_alias
table.label: Floor alias
table.description: Another system's name for a floor.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Alias key
columns.description: Set on save: the store, the source and the alias. Unique.

table.name: dash.section_alias
table.label: Section alias
table.description: Another system's name for a section.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Alias key
columns.description: Set on save: the store, the source and the alias. Unique.

table.name: dash.job_assignment
table.label: Job assignment
table.description: Who holds which job, where and when, with the HR designation beside the job. A person's coverage is worked out from their current rows, acting included.

columns.label: Job
columns.choices:
Director
Chief Operating Officer
Cluster Manager
Store Manager
Floor Manager
Department Manager
Team Leader
Staff
columns.description: The org-chart role. Separate from the designation: a promotion closes one assignment and opens the next.

columns.label: Designation
columns.description: The HR title, from the group's one designation list. Separate from the job.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The plant code of the site the person works at, as the scope filters name it. Director, Chief Operating Officer and Cluster Manager name the site they are based at, such as the corporate office.

columns.label: Cluster
columns.description: Cluster Manager only: the code of the cluster they manage, as the organisation's Cluster master names it. A store's staff get their Cluster Manager through the store's cluster, never typed in per person.

columns.label: Floor
columns.description: Floor Manager only.

columns.label: Department
columns.description: Department Manager only: one row per department.

columns.label: Section
columns.description: Team Leader and Staff only.

columns.label: Acting
columns.description: Acting cover; the absent person's row stays open.

columns.label: Assignment type
columns.description: Primary is the person's home assignment and cost centre; it stays Primary during a temporary deployment. A temporary deployment's sales count against the store the person works in.

columns.label: Percentage
columns.description: The share of the person's time. Primary and Secondary together take at most 100%; a temporary deployment takes its share out of the Primary's. Acting cover takes none.

columns.label: Ends on
columns.description: Exclusive: the first day it no longer holds. Empty means current.

table.name: dash.designation
table.label: Designation
table.description: The group's one clean list of HR titles. Each source system's spellings map to a title through designation_alias.

columns.label: Active
columns.description: Cleared for a title no longer given; job assignments that name it keep it.

columns.label: Title key
columns.description: Set on save: the title, trimmed and case-folded. Unique, so the list has each title once.

table.name: dash.display_location
table.label: Display location
table.description: An extra place a subcategory is shown, for floor audits. It never moves credit or coverage.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Subcategory
columns.description: SAP's nine-digit subcategory code (`material_group_code`).

columns.label: Ends on
columns.description: Exclusive: the first day it no longer holds. Empty means current.

table.name: dash.section_subcategory
table.label: Section subcategory
table.description: Which section owns a subcategory in a store, from starts_on up to but not including ends_on. All its credit and coverage go to that section.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Subcategory
columns.description: SAP's nine-digit subcategory code (`material_group_code`).

columns.label: Ends on
columns.description: Exclusive: the first day it no longer holds. Empty means current.

columns.label: Placement key
columns.description: Set on save: the store, the subcategory and starts_on. Unique.

table.name: dash.section
table.label: Section
table.description: One area of one store, named uniquely in that store. Its subcategories come from section_subcategory.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Floor
columns.description: One of this store's floors. Optional for a store without floors.

columns.label: Department
columns.description: One of this store's departments. Plain and undated.

columns.label: Team Leaders allowed
columns.description: How many non-acting Team Leaders this section may have. More are listed as a conflict.

columns.label: Approved headcount, minimum
columns.description: The fewest people the section is approved to have deployed. Blank until approved.

columns.label: Approved headcount, maximum
columns.description: The most people the section is approved to have deployed; at least the minimum. A range, not named slots.

columns.label: Section key
columns.description: Set on save: the store and the section name. Unique, so a store has each section name once.

table.name: dash.department
table.label: Department
table.description: A named group of sections in one store, which may span floors. A Department Manager's job assignment names one.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Department key
columns.description: The department's identity in its store. Loads match on it, and it never changes.

columns.label: Name
columns.description: Optional until the store names the department; then unique in the store.

columns.label: Department
columns.description: Set on save: the name, or the key while the name is blank.

columns.label: Department store key
columns.description: Set on save: the store and the department key. Unique per store.

columns.label: Name store key
columns.description: Set on save: the store and the name, empty while the name is blank. Unique per store.

table.name: dash.store_floor
table.label: Store floor
table.description: The floors of a store. A section names its floor; a Floor Manager's job assignment names one.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

columns.label: Floor key
columns.description: Set on save: the store and the floor name. Unique, so a store has each floor once.

table.name: dash.store_rollout
table.label: Store rollout
table.description: Stores whose people are scoped by the new store org chart, and since when. Only a System Manager writes it.

columns.label: Store
columns.description: The store's plant code, as the scope filters name it.

column.label: Pickers in the Dive
column.description: The Dive has its own Store and Month pickers: Dash sends the reader's reach and shows no bar or store heading over it.
